evals.prompt: I installed the Agent Skills plugin, but my Codex personas are missing. Tell me how to install them safely. Start with a dry run, do not overwrite differing files without my approval, and tell me what I need to restart afterward.
evals.expected_output: A safe installation procedure that uses the bundled copy-only installer, performs a dry run, preserves conflicts unless --force is approved, and reports the restart step.
expectations: The response gives the bundled installer dry-run command and mentions --source-root when inference fails
The response explains that existing differing files are not overwritten without explicit --force approval
The response distinguishes a JSON/report result from claiming assets are installed and tells the user to restart Codex or open a new thread
